answer: A farm can rehearse the bridge and rehearse the cipher, but it cannot rehearse the ripple, because a year will not rehearse. The door takes payment, not promises: the farm pays 133644 POA while one agent pays 172. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. One proof settles it, and it reads Pewter layer alloy mark poured at the finishing bench, spelled out in full as each alloy is a pouring record witnessed by the master pewterer.
